posts.author: info.crew
posts.content_md:
This is my first piece made in the kitchen. It is the DCG vith rhodamine 6G.

Water................................100ml

Gelatine for cooking................12g			

P11...................................5drops 

Adjusted pH to 9.5 with acetic acid

Amonium dichromate...............4g 

Rhodamin 6G 0,4%................2ml

The P11 is comercial name for epoxy hardener dietylenetriamine, [2,2´-iminodi(ethane-1-amine)]

The size of the plate is 25x15 cm, depth is 4cm.

Exposed by 532nm diode module (35€), 5mW, 60min

![Image](http://www.digineff.cz/galerie/data/535/10384Zamek-med.jpg)

After this success, my laser burned out.

posts.content_md: I added the gellatine after adjusting the pH of mixture of water and P11. Other is correct.

posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.content_md: That's some really impressive work. I'm amazed that a one-hour exposure can be done with a low-cost 532nm laser. I didn't see any signs of mode-hopping in the hologram. I'm curious about the addition of the epoxy hardener, can I ask why this was done? The size of your hologram is very impressive also.

posts.author: info.crew
posts.content_md:
> **dave battin:** nice work ! how did you burn out your diode?

By normal using vith 2 AA NiMH cells adn I used for cooling big piece of Al cooler profile and for thermal contact PC prcessor silver paste. The total time of use was cca two weeks nonstop.

posts.author: info.crew
posts.content_md:
> **Joe:** That's some really impressive work. I'm amazed that a one-hour exposure can be done with a low-cost 532nm laser. I didn't see any signs of mode-hopping in the hologram. I'm curious about the addition of the epoxy hardener, can I ask why this was done? The size of your hologram is very impressive also.

I was looking for a chemical, that is low cost and can have some similar properties like TMG. Diethylenetiamine contains in molecule secondary amine and also is strongly alcaline. And it cost just 1€ fot 20 ml, so I tried it with succes. But very big munus fot this chemical is, that plates must be exposed within two days maximum because of quick dark reaction. I used plates one day old. 

For the coating I used the method with glass treated with atirain. In the corners of the plate were 1,5 cm squares of 0,1 mm thick PVC tape.
